news.headline: SoftBank Shares Drop 10% as Samsung and SK Hynix Fall Over 7% in AI Sell Off
news.summary: SoftBank shares fell about 10% in Tokyo as Samsung and SK Hynix lost over 7% in an AI-linked Asian chip sell-off.

news.headline: Asian stocks rally after Wall Street rebound as Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia’s CEO
news.summary: HONG KONG (AP) — Asian stocks advanced after a rally on Wall Street as Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia’s CEO, while U. futures edged higher and oil prices fell.

news.headline: Nikkei 225 Falls 4.5% and SoftBank Plunges 15% as Wall Street’s AI Selloff Puts Asian Stocks on Track for Their Worst Week Since 2020
news.summary: The Nikkei 225 fell 4.5% in Friday's morning session and SoftBank plunged 15% as Wall Street's AI selloff reached Asia. Taiwan lost 10% in two sessions. Here is what fell most, why, and what it means for U.S. holders of Asia funds.
